# Connecting integrations

<!-- Generated by `python -m scripts.connections --markdown`; do not edit by hand. -->

Every integration is configured only through environment variables (`.env` locally, a
Kubernetes Secret/ConfigMap in production). Fill in an integration's **required**
variables, restart the API, and its tools appear for the agent. Nothing else changes.

1. Copy `.env.example` to `.env` (all variables below are already listed there).
2. Set `DEMO_MODE=false` — demo mode replaces every integration with synthetic data.
3. Fill in the required variables of the systems you use; leave the rest empty.
4. Run `python -m scripts.connections` to see what is still missing, then
   `python -m scripts.connections --check` to test the live connections.

Admins can see the same status in the API at `GET /api/v1/integrations?check=true`.

## Core (Jira, GitHub, Keka, Gmail)

### Jira Cloud (`jira`)

API token from id.atlassian.com → Security → API tokens; base URL https://<site>.atlassian.net.

- Required: `JIRA_BASE_URL`, `JIRA_EMAIL`, `JIRA_API_TOKEN`
- Optional: `JIRA_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`, `JIRA_STORY_POINTS_FIELD`
- API docs: https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/

### GitHub (`github`)

Fine-grained token: read PRs, contents, actions, checks (+ PR write for comments).

- Required: `GITHUB_TOKEN`
- Optional: `GITHUB_API_URL`, `GITHUB_ALLOWED_REPOS`, `GITHUB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`
- API docs: https://docs.github.com/rest

### Keka HRMS (`keka`)

Keka admin → Integrations → API access (client id/secret + API key).

- Required: `KEKA_BASE_URL`, `KEKA_CLIENT_ID`, `KEKA_CLIENT_SECRET`, `KEKA_API_KEY`
- Optional: `KEKA_TOKEN_URL`, `KEKA_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`
- API docs: https://developers.keka.com/

### Gmail (drafts) (`gmail`)

Google Cloud OAuth client; servers set the refresh token, local dev runs `python -m scripts.gmail_auth` once to create GMAIL_TOKEN_FILE.

- Required: `GMAIL_CLIENT_ID`, `GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET`, `GMAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN`
- Optional: `GMAIL_REDIRECT_URI`, `GMAIL_CREDENTIALS_FILE`, `GMAIL_TOKEN_FILE`, `GMAIL_ALLOWED_RECIPIENT_DOMAINS`
- API docs: https://developers.google.com/gmail/api

## Issue trackers & code hosting

### Linear (`linear`)

Linear → Settings → API → Personal API keys; LINEAR_TEAM_KEYS limits teams (e.g. ["ENG"]).

- Required: `LINEAR_API_KEY`
- Optional: `LINEAR_API_URL`, `LINEAR_TEAM_KEYS`
- API docs: https://developers.linear.app/docs/graphql/working-with-the-graphql-api

### GitLab (`gitlab`)

Personal/project access token with read_api scope; self-managed: set GITLAB_URL.

- Required: `GITLAB_TOKEN`
- Optional: `GITLAB_URL`, `GITLAB_PROJECTS`
- API docs: https://docs.gitlab.com/api/rest/

### Azure DevOps (`azure_devops`)

User settings → Personal access tokens (Work Items: Read, Code: Read).

- Required: `AZURE_DEVOPS_ORG_URL`, `AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT`
- Optional: `AZURE_DEVOPS_PROJECTS`
- API docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/azure/devops/

### Asana (`asana`)

Asana → My settings → Apps → Developer console → Personal access token.

- Required: `ASANA_TOKEN`
- Optional: `ASANA_PROJECTS`
- API docs: https://developers.asana.com/reference/rest-api-reference

### ClickUp (`clickup`)

ClickUp → Settings → Apps → API token; CLICKUP_LISTS = list ids to read.

- Required: `CLICKUP_TOKEN`
- Optional: `CLICKUP_LISTS`
- API docs: https://developer.clickup.com/reference

### Bitbucket Cloud (`bitbucket`)

Atlassian account → API tokens (Bitbucket scopes: repository, pull request read).

- Required: `BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE`, `BITBUCKET_USERNAME`, `BITBUCKET_API_TOKEN`
- Optional: `BITBUCKET_REPOS`
- API docs: https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/bitbucket/rest/

## Engineering operations

### PagerDuty (`pagerduty`)

PagerDuty → Integrations → API Access Keys (read-only key).

- Required: `PAGERDUTY_API_KEY`
- Optional: `PAGERDUTY_SERVICES`
- API docs: https://developer.pagerduty.com/api-reference/

### Opsgenie (`opsgenie`)

Opsgenie → Settings → API key management (read access); EU accounts set OPSGENIE_API_URL.

- Required: `OPSGENIE_API_KEY`
- Optional: `OPSGENIE_API_URL`
- API docs: https://docs.opsgenie.com/docs/alert-api

### Sentry (`sentry`)

Sentry → Settings → Auth Tokens (scopes: project:read, event:read); self-hosted: SENTRY_URL.

- Required: `SENTRY_TOKEN`, `SENTRY_ORG`
- Optional: `SENTRY_URL`
- API docs: https://docs.sentry.io/api/

### Jenkins (`jenkins`)

Jenkins → your user → Configure → API Token.

- Required: `JENKINS_URL`, `JENKINS_USERNAME`, `JENKINS_API_TOKEN`
- Optional: `JENKINS_JOBS`
- API docs: https://www.jenkins.io/doc/book/using/remote-access-api/

### Argo CD (`argocd`)

argocd account generate-token --account <read-only account>.

- Required: `ARGOCD_URL`, `ARGOCD_TOKEN`
- API docs: https://argo-cd.readthedocs.io/en/stable/developer-guide/api-docs/

### SonarQube / SonarCloud (`sonarqube`)

My Account → Security → Generate token (Browse permission); self-hosted: SONARQUBE_URL.

- Required: `SONARQUBE_TOKEN`
- Optional: `SONARQUBE_URL`
- API docs: https://docs.sonarsource.com/sonarqube-server/latest/extension-guide/web-api/

## HR systems

### BambooHR (`bamboohr`)

BambooHR → your name → API Keys (a user who can see time off).

- Required: `BAMBOOHR_COMPANY`, `BAMBOOHR_API_KEY`
- API docs: https://documentation.bamboohr.com/reference/get-a-list-of-whos-out-1

### Zoho People (`zoho_people`)

api-console.zoho.com → Self Client → scope ZOHOPEOPLE.forms.READ → refresh token; regional accounts use their domain (e.g. accounts.zoho.in).

- Required: `ZOHO_CLIENT_ID`, `ZOHO_CLIENT_SECRET`, `ZOHO_REFRESH_TOKEN`
- Optional: `ZOHO_ACCOUNTS_URL`, `ZOHO_PEOPLE_URL`
- API docs: https://www.zoho.com/people/api/overview.html

### Darwinbox (`darwinbox`)

Darwinbox admin → API settings (leave action API key + basic-auth user).

- Required: `DARWINBOX_URL`, `DARWINBOX_USERNAME`, `DARWINBOX_PASSWORD`, `DARWINBOX_API_KEY`
- API docs: https://darwinbox.com/

### Workday (`workday`)

Create a custom report of time off (Employee_ID, Worker, Start_Date, End_Date, Time_Off_Type, Status) enabled as a web service; use an integration system user.

- Required: `WORKDAY_LEAVE_REPORT_URL`, `WORKDAY_USERNAME`, `WORKDAY_PASSWORD`
- API docs: https://community.workday.com/

## Finance & accounting

### Zoho Books (`zoho_books`)

Same Zoho self client with scope ZohoBooks.projects.READ,ZohoBooks.expenses.READ; organization id from Settings → Organization profile.

- Required: `ZOHO_CLIENT_ID`, `ZOHO_CLIENT_SECRET`, `ZOHO_REFRESH_TOKEN`, `ZOHO_BOOKS_ORGANIZATION_ID`
- Optional: `ZOHO_BOOKS_URL`
- API docs: https://www.zoho.com/books/api/v3/

### Tally Prime (`tally`)

Tally Prime → F1 Help → Settings → Connectivity: enable the HTTP server (port 9000).

- Required: `TALLY_URL`
- Optional: `TALLY_COMPANY`
- API docs: https://help.tallysolutions.com/integration-with-tallyprime/

### SAP S/4HANA (OData) (`sap`)

Expose a CDS view / OData service with project, budget, actual and currency; a communication user with read access; map the field names if they differ.

- Required: `SAP_ODATA_URL`, `SAP_USERNAME`, `SAP_PASSWORD`
- Optional: `SAP_PROJECT_FIELD`, `SAP_BUDGET_FIELD`, `SAP_ACTUAL_FIELD`, `SAP_CURRENCY_FIELD`
- API docs: https://api.sap.com/

## CRM

### Salesforce (`salesforce`)

External Client App / Connected App with the OAuth client-credentials flow and a read-only run-as user; add an Opportunity field holding the Jira project key.

- Required: `SALESFORCE_URL`, `SALESFORCE_CLIENT_ID`, `SALESFORCE_CLIENT_SECRET`
- Optional: `SALESFORCE_API_VERSION`, `SALESFORCE_PROJECT_FIELD`
- API docs: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_rest.meta/api_rest/

### HubSpot (`hubspot`)

Settings → Integrations → Private apps (scope crm.objects.deals.read); add a deal property holding the Jira project key.

- Required: `HUBSPOT_TOKEN`
- Optional: `HUBSPOT_PROJECT_PROPERTY`
- API docs: https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/crm/deals

## Document sources (knowledge base sync)

### Confluence Cloud (`confluence`)

Atlassian API token (can reuse the Jira one); CONFLUENCE_URL=https://<site>.atlassian.net/wiki; page read-restrictions are mirrored (restricted pages become admin-only).

- Required: `CONFLUENCE_URL`, `CONFLUENCE_EMAIL`, `CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN`, `CONFLUENCE_SPACES`
- API docs: https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/confluence/rest/v2/

### Notion (`notion`)

notion.so/my-integrations → internal integration; share the pages to sync with it.

- Required: `NOTION_TOKEN`
- Optional: `NOTION_VERSION`
- API docs: https://developers.notion.com/reference/intro

### SharePoint / OneDrive (`sharepoint`)

Entra ID app registration with application permission Sites.Selected (granted to the site) or Sites.Read.All; reads .md/.txt/.pdf/.docx in the library root.

- Required: `MS_TENANT_ID`, `MS_CLIENT_ID`, `MS_CLIENT_SECRET`, `SHAREPOINT_SITE_ID`
- Optional: `SHAREPOINT_DRIVE_ID`
- API docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/resources/sharepoint

### Google Drive (`google_drive`)

Service account JSON key; share the folder with the service account (or use domain-wide delegation with GOOGLE_DELEGATED_USER).

- Required: `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_FILE`, `GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID`
- Optional: `GOOGLE_DELEGATED_USER`
- API docs: https://developers.google.com/drive/api/reference/rest/v3
